title: ever SASHIA|Fashion High-Low Deep V Neck Tulle Prom Dresses with Sequin Appliques
descriptionHtml:
A true customer favorite! This gorgeous evening dress features a sexy double deep V neckline, a sequins lace bust and long high low silhouette which allows you to walk and dance all night long without tripping over your hem. This stunning evening dress is perfect for evening party, cocktail, prom, homecoming, graduation, weddings, and any other formal affair!Prices will vary as certain colors of this style is on sale.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Knee length/High-low.

Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded , with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises tulle&sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
